meta.name: predictleads-signals
meta.description: Use when a teammate wants ad-hoc PredictLeads signals for a single company, asks "what's happening at [company]", "signals for [domain]", "enrich [domain] with PredictLeads", "pull jobs/funding/news for [company]", or wants to read previously cached signals from local SQLite without burning new credits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取公司实时信号，洞察动态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取公司招聘、融资、新闻等信号
copy.tagline_en: Get real-time company signals for insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to company signals like jobs, funding, and news

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据指令获取某个公司的 PredictLeads 信号，包括职位、融资、技术、新闻和相似公司。信号会缓存 7 天，重复查询不消耗额度。
howto.when: 当你说“what's happening at [公司]”“signals for [域名]”“enrich [域名] with PredictLeads”等，或者要求读取已缓存信号时触发。

say.note: 获取该公司所有信号类型。
读取本地缓存，不消耗额度。

say.text: pull jobs and funding for google.com
say.note: 仅获取职位和融资信号，节省额度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch PredictLeads signals for a single company (jobs, funding, tech, news, similar companies). Results are cached in local SQLite for 7 days; repeated lookups within the week cost zero credits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "what's happening at [company]", "signals for [domain]", "enrich [domain] with PredictLeads", or ask to read previously cached signals from local SQLite.

say_en.note: Fetches all signal types for HubSpot.
Reads cached data; no API call, free.

say_en.text: pull jobs and funding for google.com
say_en.note: Only fetches job and funding signals to save credits.
